messages.subject: showcase mode - any way to interactively turn on/off?
parts:
originally posted this question on 'Shiny - Web Framework for R'
no response so cross-posting here

----------------------------------------------

Dear Group,

I am wondering if there is any way, when displaying a Shiny application web page, to allow the viewer to interactively turn on/off the showcase mode?  Maybe a radio button? 

(I don't want to publish automatically with showcase mode ON due to the audience, but would like to include as an option.)

Alternatively, is there a method already established for showing the ui.R and server.R script on a separate tab(s)?

----------------------------------------------

I suppose one method would be to duplicate the webpage, with one version having showcase OFF and the other ON, with links from/to each.  I'm wondering if there isn't a more streamlined way to get at this.

Thanks.

Cliff

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] showcase mode - any way to interactively turn on/off?
parts:
Hi Cliff -

I don't think there's a way to toggle showcase mode for a given application session (that is, without reloading the page), but you could display the page with "?showcase=0" at the end of the URL to disable the showcase display.

For example, here's one from the gallery with and without showcase:
https://gallery.shinyapps.io/006-tabsets/
https://gallery.shinyapps.io/006-tabsets/?showcase=0

Note that you can only disable the showcase this way for an app that has it enabled in the DESCRIPTION with "DisplayMode: Showcase" -- you can't enable showcase with this for an app that doesn't have it enabled in the DESCRIPTION.

-Winston
